jobs.title: Sales Excellence Intern - Summer 2027 at Avery Dennison
jobs.description: Employer: Avery Dennison Expires: 11/27/2026 Sales Excellence Intern - Summer 2027 Intern About Avery DennisonAvery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency, and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital, and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.Job Description What we are looking forWe are seeking innovators, collaborators, and problem solvers. Our interns do not shy away from a challenge, and are looking for a chance to create a real impact with our company. Avery Dennison's Internship Program has a single business focus to cultivate future talent for our rapidly growing organization. With a concentrated blend of experiential on-the-job learning, a dynamic environment, access to business leaders, and an encouraging team of co-workers, peers, and supervisors, the Internship Program will provide you the opportunity to sharpen your skills and collaborate on a number of strategic projects. We're seeking a Sales Intern to join our business in North America during the summer of 2027.What you will be doingCustomer & Business Exposure: Exposure to the Avery Dennison business and our customer base.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work cross-functionally to gain business insights and exposure to various aspects of the business.Go-To-Market Strategy: Learn our go to market sales strategy and customer segmentation.Skill Development & Efficiency: Develop key skills: Build skills in areas such as project management, relationship management, customer engagement, time management and negotiation, with key focuses around sales operational efficiencies and utilizing technology (including AI) to drive better and faster results.Commercial Effectiveness: Potential project leader for enhancing commercial effectiveness or best practice.What sets us apartAvery Dennison's Summer Internship Program is unlike any other with its emphasis on networking, community and support. From Day 1, networking is encouraged, promoted and expected within the program. As you are on-boarded with other summer interns and Early Careers Program associates from various tracks, you quickly develop a community of individuals all committed to make sure you have what it takes to succeed.A core component of the curriculum is the peer mentoring program. Paired with an Early Careers Associate or program graduate within the organization, the program focuses on the transition from college to corporate, leveraging strengths and defining your early career path.In addition as an organization that values diversity and inclusion, we welcome our Summer Interns to take an active role in our Employee Resource Groups(ERG's). ERG's are a group of employees that help advance and promote diversity, cultural awareness and an inclusive work environment. Some of our ERG's are Black Employee Resource Group (BERG), Elevate(Women's Leadership Development), NEO Chinese Association, Unite(LGBT+), Veteran Employee Resource Group (VERG) and Voz Latina.Internships at Avery Dennison are paid and relocation assistance is available to those that qualify.Qualifications What you will need to bring to the program:Avery Dennison has a long history of being an industry leader. Your history is important to us. It should include the following:EducationPursuing a Bachelor's Degree (Sales Certificate or Sales Program preferred)Preferred ExperiencePrevious internship/co op experience or relevant work experience (a plus)Google suite knowledge, natural curiosity, and interest in continuous learningExperience via student organizations, such as Alpha Kappa Psi, Association of Latino Professionals of America, Multicultural Business Association, etc., or volunteerism/similar activities*Must have reliable transportation to and from work*Sponsorship is not available now or in the futureTravelAbility to travel 10 - 20 percent of the timeAdditional InformationThe hourly rate for this position is $22.00 - $27.00/hour based on where you are at academically.The hourly rate above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.Equal Opportunity StatementAll qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or other protected status. jobs.description: Employer: Allied Air Enterprises Expires: 11/27/2026 Human Resource Intern - Summer 2027Who We AreLennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us. Allied Air Enterprises is a division of Lennox International. We bring together the collective strengths of seven comfort brands – Armstrong Air, AirEase, Concord, Ducane, Allied, Allied Commercial and Magic-Pak to give distributors and dealers the ultimate source for heating and cooling solutions. From compact residential applications to large commercial projects, Allied Aire Enterprises redefines ease-of-business through breadth of product, resources and competencies unparalleled in the market. At Allied Air Enterprises, we're proof of how effective good people can be. We've based our entire business on hiring talented, dedicated professionals and giving them the resources needed to thrive. Having the right people can elevate the attitude, ideas, quality and commitment of any facility, and we're proud to say our employees do so every day. The ideal candidate is dependable, engaged, and ready to make an impact in a collaborative environment.Preferred Qualifications:Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in HRStrong verbal and written communication skillsProficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a professional settingStrong problem-solving and critical-thinking skillsPositive attitude and willingness to contribute to a culture of teamwork and continuous improvementWhat We OfferAs an Intern at Lennox, you will be a part of a team of innovative and knowledgeable industry professionals. This role will provide you with real work experiences to grow your career and provide exposure to business leaders throughout the company. Successful interns will have the potential opportunity of joining Lennox Full-Time upon graduation. Relocation and/or travel may be required for your position. Why You’ll #LoveLennox:Impactful Projects: Work on meaningful assignments that drive real business results. At Lennox, you’ll take pride in our brands, knowing you are part of something special. Come, stay, and grow with us!

jobs.description: Employer: Avery Dennison Expires: 11/27/2026 About Avery DennisonAvery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in nearly 60 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. Job Description What we are looking forWe are seeking innovators, collaborators, and problem solvers. Our interns and co-ops do not shy away from a challenge, and are looking for a chance to create a real impact with our company. Avery Dennison’s Internship & Co-Op Program has a single business focus to cultivate future talent for our rapidly growing organization. With a concentrated blend of experiential on-the-job learning, a dynamic environment, access to business leaders, and an encouraging team of co-workers, peers, and supervisors, the program will provide you the opportunity to sharpen your skills and collaborate on a number of strategic projects. We’re seeking a Marketing Communications Marketing Intern to join our business in North America for the Summer of 2027 (start date 5.24.2027) in a full- time capacity ( approx 40 hours per week) through August 2027 with the possibility to extend the assignment into a part time co op, ( approx 15 hours per week) while they are in school. The extension into Fall 2027 would be based on business needs. You will provide support for North America marketing operations. What you will be doingThe primary roles and responsibilities of this internship will be:Develop an understanding of the segments in which Avery Dennison operates and the product line team organizational structureMeet regularly with the marcom team members to gain a deep understanding of each of the 6 key areas of the function: Content & product supportEvent managementeCommerceDigital marketing and website managementCreative developmentChannel program managementExecute a study on the competitive marketing environment for 3 key High Value Category sub-segments, translating insights into recommendations on what we could do differently to market to these niche audiences.Compile and summarize findings and recommendations into clear, concise, and visually engaging reports and presentations that are within the brand guidelines. Assist in the execution of one trade marketing event alongside the events manager, learning the details of event management. This may be an industry event or a customer-facing event.Participate in the user acceptance testing for the re-launch of the eCommerce website. Run prescribed tests on the site and report findings to the eComm specialist. Research one key opportunity for the Marcom team (within any of the 6 key areas) to better utilize AI (Gemini or Salesforce agents) to manage workload and output. (For example, explore how we can automate the creation of customer communications, or updates to product collateral, or potentially how we manage personal workload by using digital tools we have access to within Avery Dennison.) What sets us apartAvery Dennison’s Summer Internship & Co-Op Program is unlike any other with its emphasis on networking, community and support. From Day 1, networking is encouraged, promoted and expected within the program. As you are on-boarded with other summer interns and Early Careers Program associates from various tracks, you quickly develop a community of individuals all committed to make sure you have what it takes to succeed.A core component of the curriculum is the mentoring program. Paired with an Early Careers Associate or program graduate within the organization, the program focuses on the transition from college to corporate, leveraging strengths, networking and defining your early career path. In addition, as an organization that values diversity and inclusion, we welcome our associates to take an active role in our Employee Resource Groups(ERG’s). ERG’s are a group of employees that help advance and promote diversity, cultural awareness and an inclusive work environment. Some of our ERG’s are Black Employee Resource Group (BERG), Elevate(Woman’s), NEO Chinese Association, Unite(LGBT+), Veteran Employee Resource Group (VERG), and Voz Latina.Internship positions at Avery Dennison are paid and relocation assistance is provided for those that qualify. Qualifications What you will need to bring to the programAvery Dennison has a long history of being an industry leader. Your history is important to us. It should include the following:EducationPursuing a BS in marketing, communications ( junior status or above) from an accredited university Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skillsPreferred ExperiencePrevious internship/co op experience or relevant work experience in technical, business-to-business (Marketing Communications) environment ( a plus)Completion of professional writing courses, workshops, or certifications is highly desirable Must have a strong interest pursuing Avery Dennison’s full-time Marketing Early Career Program upon graduation Experience working with a Salesforce systems and computer software such as Google Suite Teamwork, and leadership skills in order to cut across many diverse functional disciplines and regional culturesExperience via student organizations, such as Beta Alpha Psi, Association of Latino Professionals of America, Multicultural Business Association, American Marketing Association (AMA) Collegiate Chapters , Women in Business, or Business related organizations etc.Volunteerism or similar activitiesRequirements:*Must have reliable transportation to and from work*Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future Additional information The hourly rate for this position is $22-$27 /hour based on where you are at academically ( junior status for this position is preferredThe hourly rate above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate’s relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Expires: 11/28/2026 As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper. The Bank believes in flexibility to balance the demands of work and life while also recognizing the necessity of connecting and collaborating with our colleagues in person. Onsite work is an essential function of this position, and you are required to be onsite according to the schedule set by your management. OUR BANK - The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States and is one of the most influential, trusted, and prestigious financial organizations. It consists of twelve Reserve Banks located around the country and the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C. The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta territory covers the Sixth Federal Reserve District, which includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia, and portions of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee. The Atlanta Fed and the other Reserve Banks play an important part in all three of the Fed's functions: monetary policy, bank supervision and regulation, and the operation of a nationwide payment system. jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern at Air Liquide
jobs.description: Employer: Air Liquide - Air Liquide Expires: 11/28/2026 World leader in gases, technologies and services for Industry and Health, Air Liquide is present in 80 countries with approximately 66,000 employees and serves more than 3,6 million customers and patients. Oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen have been at the core of the company’s activities since its creation in 1902. Air Liquide’s ambition is to be the leader in its industry, delivering long-term performance and acting responsibly. How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW? We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative. At Air Liquide, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity. Air Liquide is Hiring for 2027 Summer Interns - Non Engineering in multiple locations across the US! We are looking for you ! Pay: $23.00 - $33.00 per hour Our summer internship is designed to introduce college students to Air Liquide and the industrial gas industry. Air Liquide supplies oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen and many other specialty gasses, molecules, services and technologies to a wide range of industries, providing customers with innovative solutions that are vital to their industrial production and sustainability. Located in over 78 countries, we have more than 1,000,000 customers globally in diverse industries such as steel, food and beverage, electronics and pharmaceuticals. Interns work in a specific area of Air Liquide to develop their knowledge and skills while making contacts with people at all levels of the Company. Over the course of the internship, students learn about the Air Liquide corporate identity and culture while being given opportunities to build relationships with other new employees. Below are the types of internships available: Finance and Accounting - As an intern in our FP&A group, you will have the opportunity to learn about Operations Controls leverage Business Intelligence (BI) tools to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the FP&A function. Engage in monthly financial close processes and reporting, participate in continuous improvement efforts related to industrial efficiency, and collaborate with key business stakeholders. Supply Chain and Logistics - As an intern you will have the opportunity to partner with the supply chain team and work on a continuous improvement project. Support logistics teams with meeting customer requirements, learn data management and analysis skills and gain exposure to the use of analytic, decision and information systems within the organization and supply chain. Assist during the execution of sourcing events. Support the team with market studies and cost-modeling for potential new categories to be sourced. Information Technology - Our IT division is responsible for supporting system applications for the US, Canada, Mexico, Trinidad and Colombia. Air Liquide utilizes Oracle and works with the business to determine what enhancements/new features they would like to deploy. Students will be exposed to writing design documents, working with the development team, test changes and work with end users. __________________ Are you a MATCH?Required Qualifications Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Data Science, Computer Science, Material ScienceExpected graduation of May 2029Minimum cumulative overall GPA of 3.2 (on a 4.0 scale)Must be able to provide own daily transportation to/from work Must secure and finance own housingEligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the futureMust be open and flexible to relocate anywhere in the US during and post program Preferred QualificationsPrior Internship ExperienceExperience in the industrial gas industry International Considerations: Air Liquide regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position. PLEASE NOTE: Air Liquide will not accept resumes from third party vendors. Any resumes received from an agency through our website will be considered free of any fees or charges. We are an equal opportunity employer. Everyone will be considered for employment, promotions, transfers, and other conditions of employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, physical or mental handicap, age, Vietnam era veteran status, disabled veteran status, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by state or federal law #EC27 Our Differences make our PerformanceAt Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Social Media Internship at Huntington Bank
jobs.description: Employer: Huntington Bank Expires: 11/30/2026 Summary: Huntington’s internship programs provide emerging talent with meaningful, hands‑on experience aligned to their area of study. Over the course of the interns’ time at Huntington, they gain exposure to key business functions across all segments of the organization. An intern’s experience should be focused on professional growth, skill development, and practical application of academic learning. Interns participate in a structured series of development opportunities, including interactions with senior leadership and career pathing insights. The experience also includes immersion in Huntington’s award‑winning culture through community involvement and team‑based activities. Internships at Huntington are designed to help students build a strong foundation for future career success while contributing to meaningful business initiatives. Internship Opportunities at Huntington: Huntington offers internship opportunities for students who are currently enrolled in an academic program and seeking practical, hands‑on experience in their field of study. Internships take place during a defined period of time and are available across all business segments. Rising juniors (Winter 2028 or Spring 2029 grads) may participate in Huntington's Foundations Program, an 8-week, regionally focused experience where students partner directly with a manager and team, contribute to meaningful projects, build professional skills, and explore career opportunities across Huntington and the financial services industry. All interns participate in a variety of developmental and professional activities designed to support learning and exposure to the organization. Depending on your school year, program components may include: Experience in day‑to‑day responsibilities related to their assigned team Exposure to broader business functions A structured schedule of professional development sessions Opportunities to engage with members of the Executive Leadership Team Discussions with senior leaders regarding career paths and Huntington’s business areas A team project focused on applying Huntington’s innovation framework to a business‑relevant problem Participation in volunteer activities and internal events aligned with Huntington’s culture Social Media Internship Overview Huntington Bank is seeking creative, curious and collaborative college students to join our Social Media Internship Program.Eligibility note: This internship is open to rising college juniors enrolled during Summer 2027 at one of the Huntington partner schools for this program: University of Michigan, University of Minnesota, West Virginia University, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, University of Mississippi, University of Alabama or Mississippi State University.This internship offers hands-on experience across the full social media content lifecycle within a highly regulated industry. Interns will join Huntington’s editorial content team and work alongside social media, brand, creative, video and production partners to learn how content moves from initial concept through creation, approval, publication and performance evaluation.Each intern will come from one of Huntington’s partner universities and bring their campus perspective into the program. Working remotely from their home communities, with hybrid in-office participation for Columbus-based interns, interns will contribute ideas, insights and content recommendations that help Huntington connect with customers, communities and university audiences across our footprint. As part of the experience, each intern will develop localized content guidance that reflects their campus, student audience and community context. Duties & Responsibilities: Collaborate with fellow interns and mentors to develop social media concepts grounded in audience needs, business goals, cultural moments and emerging platform opportunities.Participate in brainstorming, creative reviews and content planning discussions by presenting concepts, explaining recommendations and contributing constructive feedback.Work with the editorial content team member who creates and delivers Huntington’s advice and guidance newsletter to identify relevant articles and incorporate them into social plans in ways that are useful, timely and audience-aware.Create, edit, optimize and adapt content for a variety of social platforms and formats, including original photo or video content when opportunities arise and repurposed brand, event or partnership assets.Develop a localized social content toolkit, guide or plan for their Huntington partner university, helping the team understand campus culture, student needs, relevant moments and content opportunities, then present their recommendations to the brand team and other relevant Huntington stakeholders at the end of the internship.Support content planning, workflow management, project execution and performance analysis to help improve future social media content. What You'll LearnContent Strategy, Concept Development & Audience Insight: Learn how leading brands identify audience needs, generate ideas and build content strategies that support business objectives, audience engagement, relevant cultural moments and localized opportunities for Huntington partner universities.Content Creation, Storytelling & Editorial-to-Social Integration: Develop skills in social-first storytelling, content production, copywriting, editing, platform adaptation and content optimization, including how advice and guidance articles can be adapted into useful, timely social plans.Creative Pitching, Collaboration & Feedback: Gain experience presenting ideas, explaining creative rationale, communicating recommendations to peers and stakeholders, and refining work through constructive feedback and collaboration.Project Management: Understand how projects move from concept to completion through planning, timelines, approvals and stakeholder coordination.Brand Standards, Compliance & Reputational Risk: Experience how content is created and reviewed within a regulated financial services environment while balancing strong creative ideas with brand standards, business objectives, risk management and reputational considerations.Measurement & Assessment: Learn how social media content is evaluated and how performance insights are used to improve future content strategies. Required SkillsStrong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly.Enthusiasm for social media and a thoughtful understanding of its value, influence, challenges and responsibility as a public-facing communication channel.Creativity, curiosity and willingness to contribute new ideas.Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Comfort working independently in a remote environment and collaborating effectively with others.Openness to giving, receiving and incorporating constructive feedback. Preferred SkillsExperience creating content for personal, academic, volunteer, student organization, freelance or professional channels, including social media posts, video, photography, graphics, copywriting or other digital storytelling formats.Comfort using creative tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Final Cut Pro, in-app editing tools within social platforms or similar platforms to edit, design or adapt content.Interest in how social platforms work, including audience engagement, trends, platform best practices and the role social media can play in building connection, trust and action.Experience contributing to group projects, events, campaigns or creative initiatives, including presenting ideas, collaborating with peers and working toward a shared goal. QualificationsRising college junior enrolled during Summer 2027 at one of the Huntington partner schools for this program: University of Michigan, University of Minnesota, West Virginia University, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, University of Mississippi, University of Alabama or Mississippi State University.Pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, Advertising, Public Relations, Film, Digital Media or a related field. Application ProcessCandidates selected to advance in the interview process will be asked to complete a brief creative exercise demonstrating their understanding of social media audiences, content strategy and storytelling.

jobs.description: Employer: Nissan North America Expires: 11/30/2026 Job DescriptionLocation(s): Franklin, TNJob Schedule: Full-time, 12-week programDegree Level: Master's Level StudentsPreferred Degree: Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related fieldSponsorship: Not Available Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation We are currently looking for a Procurement Transformation Intern to join our team in Franklin, TN. Join the Nissan Americas Indirect Procurement and Procurement Transformation team as we modernize how Nissan sources the goods and services that support the business. Our team combines strategic sourcing and category management with digital procurement, analytics, automation, process improvement, training, and governance to drive operational excellence. Who We’re Looking For:Required:Must be currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.Strong problem-solving, written communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.Experience creating documentation, training materials, or supporting user adoption activities.Foundational experience with Python and data analysis techniques.Exposure to SQL, APIs, data querying, data preparation, visualization tools, or libraries such as pandas.Ability to learn new technologies quickly and validate results independently.Experience or strong interest in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, or similar AI and workflow automation platforms.Familiarity with generative AI solutions and prompt engineering concepts.Understanding of how to develop structured prompts, evaluate model responses, identify unsupported outputs, and refine instructions.Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate business needs into practical AI, analytics, and automation solutions.Interest in procurement, sourcing, digital transformation, process improvement, automation, and emerging technologies.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.)Ability to perform work onsite at Franklin, TN. What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen relationships and collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds, fostering a culture of belonging. Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms, certifications, and leadership development programs.

jobs.description: Employer: Nissan North America Expires: 11/30/2026 Job DescriptionLocation(s): Franklin, TNJob Schedule: Full-time, 12-week programDegree Level: Junior - Senior Preferred Degree: Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, or related fieldSponsorship: Not Available Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation We are currently looking for a Purchasing Transformation Intern to join our team in Franklin, TN. This internship provides hands-on experience at the intersection of business, technology, analytics, automation, and digital transformation.You will work closely with business stakeholders and technology teams on projects involving data collection, reporting, automation, visualization, and AI-enabled solutions. What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging. Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms, and leadership trainings.

The AP Analyst works collaboratively with attorneys, administrative departments and external vendors to maintain financial integrity and operational efficiency within a fast-paced, professional environment. jobs.title: 2027 METx Data & Analytics Intern at MetLife
jobs.description: Employer: MetLife - Global Technology and Operations Expires: 11/30/2026 The Team You Will JoinAt MetLife, data isn’t just a tool – it is a catalyst for growth. As part of our Data & Analytics organization, you’ll unlock trusted insights that drive bold decisions, power personalized customer experiences, and deliver lasting business impact. We’re building the future of data – one that’s governed responsibly, engineered for scalability, and designed for growth. When you join us, you’re not just supporting the business – you’re empowering it. Let’s transform insight into impact and data into action, together. The OpportunityAs a METx Data & Analytics undergraduate intern, you’ll work alongside experienced data professionals, contribute to real projects, and share your outcomes and learning experiences with peers and leaders at the end of the program. Our program is designed for students who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies in a collaborative, innovative environment. Key ResponsibilitiesOur interns work on meaningful projects impacting millions of customers, receive mentorship from highly skilled data experts and industry leaders, and build robust technical skills. At the end of the internship, you will have a chance to share your project outcomes and learning experiences with peers and leaders. Intern projects may include: Data Engineering & Pipeline Automation: Automate data pipelines using Azure and Databricks to support business reporting.Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics: Develop machine learning models to predict customer behavior, pricing, threat monitoring, and other outcomes based on historical data patterns.Generative AI & Agentic AI Innovation: Brainstorm and develop potential GenAI and Agentic AI solutions to enhance operations and capabilities.Analytics Solution Development: Develop and test analytics solutions, including writing Databricks notebooks and validating data.Business Process Analysis & Improvement: Analyze, identify opportunities for improvement, and document business processes to support data-driven projects.Data Visualization & Reporting: Build dashboards and reports to visualize key business metrics.Production Support & Incident Management: Provide production support and help resolve data-related incidents.Data Governance & Management: Document key data assets, apply data governance standards, and support data management to improve transparency and compliance.Strategic Initiatives & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Support strategic or operational initiatives while collaborating with cross-functional teams. Required QualificationsCurrently pursuing a bachelor’s degree or post-secondary training in Data Science, Business Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.Must have an expected graduation date no later than June 2029.Minimum GPA of 3.0.Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify patterns and insights from data as demonstrated through academic coursework or personal projects.Coursework or experience with at least one programming language or analytics tool (e.g., Python, SQL, Scala, C#, C++).Ability to analyze, ingest, and organize raw data and perform data transformation for modeling.Knowledge of or experience using AI models, integrating AI-enabled solutions into business or technical workflows.Desire to learn new technologies, tools, and business processes.Strong communication and critical thinking, and teamwork skills.Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset. Preferred QualificationsExposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) or cloud platforms.Familiarity with cloud-based data and analytics environments, particularly Microsoft Azure and Databricks.Experience with collaborative tools (e.g., GitHub, Azure DevOps) or agile methodologies.Exposure to data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Ataccama, EDC).Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate).Experience with data pipelines, systems, and process design.Exposure to advanced analytics, machine learning, and feature engineering. Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in office. The expected salary range for this position is $28-30 /Hour. About MetLife Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value. jobs.title: Quant Trading Internship - Summer 2027 at Chicago Trading Company
jobs.description: Employer: Chicago Trading Company Expires: 11/30/2026 The Role As a Quant Trading (QT) Intern, you will be challenged to learn and adapt in an exciting team environment and will play a substantial role in our day-to-day trading and quant-related activities. Your impact is immediate and meaningful. You will become a member of a team for the summer and play a vital role completing project work and/or identifying trading opportunities and communicating with software engineers, quants, traders, and risk managers throughout the trading day. As part of the Summer Associate cohort, you will learn and socialize alongside other QT Interns and Software Engineering (SE) Interns.What to ExpectThe 8-week internship program gives you insight into our culture and an inward look into what our business is all about. You will participate in three classroom learning experiences including: a week-long Basics of Options class, a multi-week class on the fundamentals of market making (Mock Trading), and a multi-week class that introduces elements of our quant framework (Quant Curriculum). You will also attend planned social activities and talks from various business leaders to propel your professional growth, and build your network with CTC employees and fellow interns. You will:Work in an impactful role mirroring that of a full-time Quant Trading Associate (QTA)Get hands-on experience with trading and exposure to our trading technologyHave weekly one-on-one meetings with your manager to ensure you are progressing and learning throughout the programReceive mentorship from members of our trading and/or quant teamsExperience a culture with a strong emphasis on teamwork and collaboration built through various educational and social activitiesWhat it takes for you to be successful You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative teamYou have a desire to work in tandem with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC’s goal of providing world class liquidity to financial marketsYou love solving complex problemsYou’re intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quoYou can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verballyStrong quantitative and analytical abilitiesBasic programming skills or a willingness to learn PythonNo prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and hunger to learn about finance and trading is essentialKey Requirements You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome.You will graduate between December 2027-June 2028You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.)You are willing to relocate to Chicago, IL for the summer (with full-time placement in Chicago)You can participate in the full duration of the 8-week program from mid-June to early August 2027Why should you consider interning at CTC?Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading companyWork in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflowsOpportunity to work with and learn from leaders in our industryExcellent support system to ensure your learning and developmentCompetitive pay, free housing with your fellow interns in downtown Chicago, and free breakfast, lunch, and snacks!CompensationMonthly salary of $14,500 plus a signing bonus Please note: You are allowed to submit one application per position (i.e. SE Intern and QT Intern) during the recruiting cycle. We recommend focusing on applying for the role that aligns most closely with your skills and interests. While you can apply for more than one role, please keep in mind that each application will be assessed according to the specific requirements set for that role.

jobs.description: Employer: DriveTime Family of Brands Expires: 11/30/2026 What’s Under the Hood DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance & servicing company in the nation. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time. Your job is not only to find the problem, but more importantly, find the solution.Agile in a fast-paced environment. We move, and we move quickly. Thriving in an environment that never stops, is a must.Intellectual curiosity. Why? What? How? Do you find yourself always wanting to learn more and broaden your knowledge base? If so, this could be the role for you!Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma and competence for a wide variety of audiences including management. The Specifics.Bachelors or Master’s student with a graduation date between December 2027 – May 2028Pursuing a quantitative degree in Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or other STEM fieldsYou have a GPA of 3.5 or higherData analysis experienceWorking knowledge in SQL, Python, Tableau and ExcelOur internship program is 11 weeks starting May 2027 – August 2027Internships will be base out of our Home offices in Tempe, AZ and Dallas, TXYou can expect a regular on-site schedule; Monday-Friday, 40 hours per weekRelocation not provided for internship So What About the Perks? You will be mentored by industry professionals, be given guidance along the way, and the tools to be successful.Philanthropy: Give for Good. We are proud to be difference makers in our communities. We dedicate time for our Interns to give back with us.Gratitude is Green. Out Internship Program is paid, because, well… money matters! Anything Else? Absolutely.DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)! Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!
